description: The first-run import screen and its dialogs. src/import/ui/strings.cpp holds the same English as the fallback for a missing gamedata; {0} to {3} are filled in by the program.

strings.ui.import.intro_need_image: The game data has not been imported yet. A Silent Hill disc image (NTSC USA 1.1, SLUS-007.07) is required. It is unpacked once into {0}; after that the image is not needed.
strings.ui.import.intro_formats: Accepted: .cue, .bin (MODE2/2352), an .iso saved as raw (2352 bytes per sector), or a .zip holding them.
strings.ui.import.setting_verify: Verify the result after the import ({0})
strings.ui.import.ready_body: The game data is already in {0}.
strings.ui.import.cancelling_body: Stopping the import; the unfinished result will be removed.

strings.ui.import.done_body: The game data is saved in {0}.
strings.ui.import.cancelled_body: Nothing was written to the game data directory.
strings.ui.import.aborted_body: The game needs the imported data. Start it again and give the image.
strings.ui.import.err_is_directory: {0} is a directory. An image file (.cue or .bin) is required.
strings.ui.import.err_cue_no_file: The .cue file {0} has no FILE line naming the image.

strings.ui.import.err_not_raw: The file does not look like a disc image: the CD sync pattern is missing at the start of the sector. A .bin/.cue (MODE2/2352) or an .iso saved as raw is required.
